messages.subject: Re: Plot Builder in Rattle 2.6.25
parts:
On 26 January 2013 15:17, William Kong <wwko...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi there,

I recently updated my version of rattle directly from the Togaware repo to 2.6.25 but now I'm having issues with the plot builder. Specifically, it won't read any .csv files that are loaded into rattle as data. Is anyone else having this issue?

Hi William,

Thanks for reporting the issue.

To have Plot Builder find the Rattle dataset I was assigning it temporarily to a variable in the Global Environment. The CRAN policy (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/policies.html) notes that "Packages should not modify the global environment" - rattle could potentially wipe out a dataset in the Global Environment if it had the same name. 

CRAN (Ripley) suggested that Rattle would not be updated on CRAN unless it complied with Policy. So I've removed the assignment until I identify a better solution. 

One work-around is to do the following yourself (which is what Rattle was automatically doing) in the R Console just prior to clicking the Execute button in Rattle to start up Plot Builder:

> ds <- crs$dataset

Plot Builder will then see the dataset.

I've also temporarily re-enabled this in the 2.6.26 beta available now on Togaware:

> install.packages("rattle", repo="http://rattle.togaware.com")

Plot Builder is such a great tool - I'll try and work out another solution that conforms to CRAN policy to have it work seamlessly with Rattle.

Graham Williams
